steps: Obtain a Moomoo OAuth 2.1 access token with quote read permission.
Store the access token only in the current local/runtime environment as MOOMOO_ACCESS_TOKEN. Do not commit it or paste it into JSON.
Run npm run moomoo:first-live-import. P2-P2 calls only GET /api/v1.0/quote/{symbol}/history-kline for the eight planned U.S. market/sector instruments.
The importer paginates backward using next_time, strips all credential headers, and writes sanitized provider payloads into market-provider-intake-v1.json.
Run npm run build:runtime-position-48:w8a:p2 to compute governed response digests and normalized snapshots.
Run npm run check:runtime-position-48:w8a:p2 and inspect the provider review before W8B provider claim extraction.
